lines.japanese: 息を切らして踊りこんだ礼拝堂には、寒々しい冬の陽光が射しこんでいるだけだった。
lines.english: I burst into the chapel, out of breath. Cold winter sunlight was all that greeted me.

lines.japanese: 冷えきったがらんどうの堂内に俺の白い息が乱れちった。
lines.english: My breath came out in ragged white clouds and scattered through the cold, empty chapel.
“Damn it...”

lines.japanese: 俺は教会から去るじいさんを見送ることが出来なかった。
lines.english: I had failed to see the old man off when he left the church.

lines.japanese: 偉い医者だか何だかに「安定している」なんて言われてはみても、いまほど完璧ではなかったあの頃、俺はじいさんが教会を去る日≪コックピット≫に入ることが出来なかった。
lines.english: Some big-shot doctor or other may have called us “stable,” but back then, before we had things worked out the way we do now, I couldn’t reach the *Cockpit* on the day the old man left.

lines.japanese: あとになって鷲介と≪面談≫して分かったことだが、じいさんを見送ったのはタカシだったらしい。せめて鷲介だったら、じいさんの最後の様子を詳しく伝えきくことが出来たのに。
lines.english: I learned later, in an *Interview* with Shusuke, that Takashi had been the one to see him off. If only it had been Shusuke, I could at least have heard what the old man was like when he left.

lines.japanese: 俺はこのとき初めて、俺たちがばらばらでなければ良かったのにと思った。皮肉な話。
lines.english: For the first time, I wished we weren't separate. There was an irony for you.

lines.japanese: ざわ、と立ちつくしていた俺の背後でひとの声がした。
lines.english: A murmur of voices rose behind me as I stood rooted there.

lines.japanese: 振りかえった。ロビーに知らないジジババたちが溜まっていた。寝起きのアル中みたいなちりちり頭のじいさんが、俺の大好きだったじいさんの服を来て下品な笑い声を立てていた。
lines.english: I turned. Old men and women had gathered in the lobby. A frizzy-haired old man who looked like a drunk just out of bed was wearing the clothes of the man I had loved, laughing in a coarse voice.

lines.japanese: 俺は礼拝堂に向きなおって祭壇を睨みあげた。ただのがらくた。だから俺は何度も言ったじゃないか──神なんていねえよ。
lines.english: I faced the chapel again and glared up at the altar. Nothing but junk. I told you again and again—there is no God.

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの真似をして後ろ頭をがしがし掻きながら呟いた。
lines.english: Raking the back of my head in imitation of him, I muttered.

lines.japanese: 「じいさん。約束は守るよ」
lines.english: “I'll keep my promise, old man.”

lines.japanese: それからジジババの群れを突っ切ってロビーを渡り、教会を去った。
lines.english: Then I cut through the herd of old people, crossed the lobby, and left the church.

lines.japanese: それ以来、俺があそこに足を運ぶことはなかった。
lines.english: I never set foot there again.

lines.japanese: その後、俺と鷲介はじいさんの赴任先へ宛てて月に一度くらい手紙を出した。
lines.english: After that, Shusuke and I sent a letter about once a month to the old man's new posting.

lines.japanese: 面倒な「拝啓」やら「春まだ寒いこのごろ」やらは鷲介に任せた。
lines.english: I left all the tiresome formalities—the “Dear Sir” and the “though spring is still cold” sort of thing—to Shusuke.

lines.japanese: やつは小癪なオトナ文字で、ぼちぼち始めたアルバイトのことや次々に広がってゆく交遊関係のこと、それから≪病状≫の経過なんかも綴ってたみたいだ。
lines.english: In his irritatingly grown-up hand, he apparently wrote about the part-time work he'd begun picking up, his ever-widening circle of friends, and the progress of our *condition*.

lines.japanese: 俺は筆圧の高い角張った文字で、最近注目のプロボクサーやらお勧めのジャンクフードやらを伝えた。
lines.english: In my heavy, angular hand, I told him about professional boxers who had caught my eye and junk food worth trying.

lines.japanese: 半年ぐらいは羽田小鳩宛で達筆な説教くさい返信があったけど、ある頃からそれが途絶えた。
lines.english: For about six months, replies addressed to Kobato Haneda came back in elegant handwriting, full of preachy advice. Then, at some point, they stopped.

lines.japanese: さらに何ヵ月かして、やつのカミさんというひとから手紙が来た。
lines.english: Several months later, a letter came from his wife.

lines.japanese: 旦那がナントカって難しい名前の脳の病気でしばらく入院してたことと、最期まで旦那の友達でいてくれてありがとうってことが、平仮名多めのあったかい文字で書いてあった。
lines.english: Her handwriting was warm, with the harder words spelled out phonetically. She wrote that her husband had been in the hospital with some brain disease whose difficult name I couldn’t remember, and thanked us for staying his friends to the end.

lines.japanese: （俺が漢字に弱いってことを旦那から聞いていたらしい。失礼な話）
lines.english: (Apparently her husband had told her I wasn’t good with the complicated characters. Rude.)

lines.japanese: カミさんの伝によれば、じいさんは痴呆が始まったころ、見舞いに来た孫や元教え子たちをたびたび俺や鷲介と間違っていたらしい。
lines.english: According to his wife, once the old man's dementia began, he often mistook grandchildren and former students visiting him for me or Shusuke.

lines.japanese: こら隼人、そんなムスッとしてたら女にもてんぞ。とつぜん若々しい声でそんなことを言いだしては、周囲の人間を狼狽させていたそうだ。俺は苦笑した。巨大なお世話だ。
lines.english: ‘Hey, Hayato. Keep scowling like that and you'll never get a girl.’ He would suddenly say something like that in a young man's voice, throwing everyone around him into confusion. I smiled bitterly. None of his damn business.

lines.japanese: やつの訃報を受けとって、鷲介は下を向いて涙を落とした。俺は上を向いて無人の天に鼻息を飛ばした。
lines.english: When word of his death arrived, Shusuke lowered his head and let the tears fall. I looked up and blew a snort at the empty heavens.

lines.japanese: 正直者の聖職者は、地上に楽園などないと漏らした。そんな不毛の大地で弱者を導きながら、何十年という永く苦しい旅をまっとうしたあいつは本当に大したやつだと思う。かっこいい。超かっこいい。
lines.english: The honest clergyman had let slip that there was no paradise on earth. He guided the weak across that barren land and completed a long, painful journey of decades. He really was something. Cool. So goddamn cool.

lines.japanese: 「お疲れ、じいさん」
lines.english: “You earned your rest, old man.”

lines.japanese: 右半身を打った衝撃に、眠りが破られた。
lines.english: An impact against the right side of my body shattered my sleep.

lines.japanese: 「いってぇ……ンだよ……」
lines.english: “That hurts... What the hell...”

lines.japanese: 思わずしわがれ声がこぼれた。点けっぱなしのエアコンのせいだろうか、喉がからからだった。いつの間にか照明が落とされていたらしく、硬いまぶたをこじ開けてみてもぼんやりとものの輪郭が見えるだけだ。
lines.english: A hoarse voice escaped me. Maybe it was the air conditioner left running, but my throat was parched. At some point the lights had been turned off. Even when I pried my stiff eyelids apart, all I could see were vague outlines.

lines.japanese: なんだコレ。超・目の前になにかある。ソファーにしちゃ低い。俺はうつ伏せの体を片肘で支え、残る一方の手を闇の中の稜線に伸ばしてみた。
lines.english: What was this? Something was right—*right*—in front of me. Too low to be the sofa. Lying on my stomach, I propped myself on one elbow and reached my other hand toward the ridge in the darkness.

lines.japanese: ふにっ。
lines.english: Squish.

lines.japanese: え。
lines.english: What?

lines.japanese: え、なに……なに、ふにって。
lines.english: What was... What had gone squish?

lines.japanese: 眉間に皺を寄せて目を凝らすと……暗さに順応した瞳孔がようやく解答を映しだした。
lines.english: I knitted my brow and peered into the dark. At last my eyes adjusted, and the answer came into view.

lines.japanese: 次の瞬間、眠気が吹きとんだ。
lines.english: In the next instant, every trace of sleep vanished.

lines.japanese: ちょっ……おまえコレ、パル姐さんの胸の脂肪じゃねえか……！
lines.english: Wait... that was Paru’s breast under my hand, wasn’t it?!

lines.japanese: 脂肪の向こうから身じろぐ女の声がした。俺は咄嗟に頭を下げて寝たふりを装った。やべえ誤解されると思った瞬間、無意識にそうしていた。
lines.english: A woman’s voice sounded somewhere beyond my hand as Paru stirred. I ducked my head and pretended to sleep before I even knew what I was doing. She might think I’d touched her on purpose.

lines.japanese: ──おかげで手を放すタイミングを逸してしまった。
lines.english: —Which cost me the chance to move my hand away.

lines.japanese: ど、どうすんだよコレ。
lines.english: Wh-what was I supposed to do now?

lines.japanese: パルさんの脂肪に張りついた手が、身体的緊張を強いられて熱くなる。
lines.english: My hand was still planted on Paru’s chest, growing hot with the strain of holding still.

lines.japanese: てのひらがカップに宛がわれて、ちょうど脂肪を下から押しあげている格好だ。仰向けで横たわってるくせに大した肉厚感が伝わってくる。
lines.english: My palm was cupped beneath it, pushing it up. Even lying flat on her back, she had more there than I’d expected.

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの性別を思いだして微妙な気分に陥った。
lines.english: I remembered that she was a woman and felt... odd.

lines.japanese: いや、そんなもにょもにょしてる場合じゃない。とにかくアレだ、手を外そう。
lines.english: No time to get tangled up in that. First I had to get my hand off her.

lines.japanese: ゆっくり、ゆっくり……起こさないように……。
lines.english: Slowly, slowly… without waking her…

lines.japanese: 「ぐぅぅー！　がごごご！」
lines.english: “Hrrrrk! Gngngng!”

lines.japanese: 俺は咄嗟の高いびきで、寝相の悪いやんちゃな男の子を装った。
lines.english: I started snoring thunderously on the spot, trying to pass for a rowdy little boy with terrible sleeping habits.

lines.japanese: しかし闇夜に響いたその騒音は、パルさんよりむしろもうひとりの気を引いてしまった。
lines.english: But the noise echoing through the dark drew the attention of the other sleeper more than it did Paru's.

lines.japanese: 「えぇ……なにぃ……」
lines.english: “Huh...? Whaaat...?”

lines.japanese: どこか後ろの方でうめくような声。
lines.english: A groaning voice sounded somewhere behind me.

lines.japanese: く、くそ、亜衣かよ。ややこしくなるから起きてくるんじゃ──
lines.english: D-damn it, Ai. Don't wake up and make this more complicated—

lines.japanese: 「あぁ、なんだ亜衣か……変なとこ触んなよ……」
lines.english: “Oh, it's just Ai… Don't touch me in weird places…”
—What?

lines.japanese: 「んん……ごめんぴぃ……」
lines.english: “Mmm… Sorryyy…”

lines.japanese: ──えええ？
lines.english: —What!?

lines.japanese: 「ふぅ……あむ……」
lines.english: “Whew... Mmph...”

lines.japanese: パルさんは勘違いしたまま、俺に背中を向けて寝返りを打った。勢い俺の腕はぼとりと落ちた。
lines.english: Still mistaken about who had touched her, Paru rolled over and turned her back to me. My arm dropped heavily free.

lines.japanese: 「すぅ……すぅ……」
lines.english: “Hhhh... hhhh...”

lines.japanese: そして鳳家のリビングに静寂が戻った。
lines.english: And silence returned to the Otori living room.

lines.japanese: た、助かった……よく分かんないけど……。
lines.english: S-saved... Somehow...

lines.japanese: 俺は俺に代わって謝罪してくれた亜衣に感謝しつつ、安堵の溜息を吐いて上半身を起こした。寝入り端そうしていたように、ふたたび腕を組んでソファーの縁に背をもたせた。
lines.english: Grateful to Ai for apologizing in my place, I breathed out in relief and raised my upper body. I folded my arms once more and leaned against the edge of the sofa, the way I'd been when I first drifted off.

lines.japanese: そのとき──
lines.english: Just then—

lines.japanese: ──なにか、たぶんドアノブを回すような音がして、俺はついまた狸寝入りを再開してしまった。いや、ついさっきの続きで。
lines.english: —I heard something, maybe a doorknob turning, and slipped straight back into pretending to sleep. Well, I was only picking up where I’d left off.

lines.japanese: ソファーの座面に頭を載せて目を閉じていると、左耳にドアが開く蝶番の音と、誰かのかすかな足音が聞こえた。
lines.english: Head on the sofa cushion, eyes shut, I heard a door hinge open to my left, then somebody's faint footsteps.

lines.japanese: 俺は暗がりの中で薄目を開けてみた。入口のそばに、積みかさねられた布の塊が浮いている。
lines.english: I cracked my eyes in the dark. Near the entrance floated a mound of layered cloth.

lines.japanese: 一瞬なにごとか思ったが、よく見ればそれは、小さすぎる体に毛布四枚を抱えたこの家の長女だった。
lines.english: For an instant I couldn't make sense of it. Then I looked harder and found the eldest daughter of the house, her tiny body carrying four blankets.

lines.japanese: 手伝ってやろうかと背中を浮かしかけたが、手を貸すまでもなくやつはその場に毛布の山を下ろして、ふぅとひと仕事終えたあとの満足げな息をついていた。
lines.english: I started to get up and help her, but before I could move, she set the mountain of blankets down and let out the satisfied sigh of a job well done.

lines.japanese: 俺はふたたび背中をソファーのへりに預けた。鳴は俺が起きていることにも気付かず、毛布置き場と俺たちそれぞれのところをちょこまかと三往復して、それぞれに一枚ずつ毛布を掛けていった。
lines.english: I settled against the sofa again. Not noticing I was awake, Naru scurried three times between the blanket pile and each of us, draping one over every person.

lines.japanese: 部屋は暖房のせいでちょっと暑いぐらいだったけれど、流れるような毛ざわりの高級そうな毛布は覆いかぶさる感じがなく、ほのかに優しい香りがして心地良かった。
lines.english: The heating made the room almost too warm, but the expensive-looking blanket was silky and light. It settled over me without weighing me down and carried a faint, pleasant scent.

lines.japanese: どーも。
lines.english: Thanks.

lines.japanese: しかし俺はその礼を口に出さず、薄目のまま鳴の観察を続けた。
lines.english: But I kept the thanks to myself. Through narrowed eyes, I went on watching Naru.

lines.japanese: げ。
lines.english: Gah.

lines.japanese: 一瞬、目が合ったかと思った。やつは首を曲げてこっちを見ていた。しかしよく考えればこの暗さだ、俺のまぶたが完全に閉じていないと判別できるはずはない。
lines.english: For an instant, I thought our eyes met. She had cocked her head and was looking my way. But in darkness like this, there was no chance she could tell my lids weren't fully closed.

lines.japanese: やつは毛布置き場に残った最後の一枚、その端を片手に掴んで脇に垂らしていた。垂れた毛布は、清潔なフローリングの床にこんもりとわだかまっている。
lines.english: She held one corner of the last blanket in the pile, letting it hang at her side. The trailing cloth lay in a soft heap on the spotless wooden floor.

lines.japanese: つうか、なんだよ。なに見てんだてめえ。
lines.english: What the hell? What are you looking at?

lines.japanese: 俺の体は固まったまま視線に晒されている。熟視するな。俺を熟視するな。
lines.english: My body remained frozen under her gaze. Don't stare. Quit staring at me.

lines.japanese: しばらく突っ立っていた鳴の唇が、花開く朝顔の早送り映像みたいにふわあっと広がっていった（珍しいものを見てしまった、あの口はいつもああやって開くのか）。
lines.english: After a while, Naru's lips slowly opened like time-lapse footage of a morning glory blooming. (A rare sight. Was that how her mouth always opened?)

lines.japanese: やつはいつものようにぽかんと口を開けたまま、やがて一回二回とゆっくり首を縦に振りはじめた。どうやら考え事に解決策を見出したようだ。
lines.english: Mouth hanging vacantly open as usual, she began at last to nod, slowly: once, twice. Apparently she'd found the answer to whatever problem she was considering.

lines.japanese: やつは最後に大きく一回頷くと、リビングとひと続きのダイニングキッチンへ毛布を引きずっていった。そしてカウンターの奥へ回り──屈みこんだんだろう、姿が消えた。
lines.english: After one last emphatic nod, she dragged the blanket into the adjoining dining and kitchen area. She passed behind the counter, then disappeared—she must have crouched.

lines.japanese: ふたたび立ちあがってリビングへ戻ってくるとき、なぜかやつの手には毛布がなかった。
lines.english: When she stood and returned to the living room, somehow the blanket was no longer in her hands.

lines.japanese: ……なんだ？
lines.english: ...What?

lines.japanese: ボリュームを抑えた鼻歌が接近してくる。俺は薄目が気付かれないよう、気持ち顎を引いた。ふわりと空気が動いて、気付くとやつが俺の斜め前に腰を落としていた。
lines.english: Quiet humming drew closer. I tucked my chin slightly so she wouldn't notice my narrowed eyes. The air stirred softly, and before I knew it, she'd crouched diagonally in front of me.

lines.japanese: あれ……なんだよ、起きてんのバレてたのか？
lines.english: Wait... Did she know I was awake?

lines.japanese: 「ん、んんっ」
lines.english: “Ahem, ahem.”

lines.japanese: 鳴は俺の顔を横から覗きこんで、押しころした小さな咳払いをした。
lines.english: Naru peered at my face from the side and gave a tiny, suppressed cough.

lines.japanese: 「あのー、隼人さん起きてますかー」
lines.english: “Um, Hayato? Are you awake?”

lines.japanese: アイドルの寝室に侵入する突撃レポーターみたいな声。やっぱり気付かれてはいないのか。試しに俺は、すぅすぅと嘘の寝息で答えた。
lines.english: She sounded like a TV reporter sneaking into an idol’s bedroom for a surprise wake-up segment. So she hadn’t noticed after all? As a test, I answered with soft, fake sleeping breaths.
“...Good.”

lines.japanese: なんだ。なんだ、よしって。なんだ、その小っさいガッツポーズ。
lines.english: What? What do you mean, good? And what was that tiny little victory pose?

lines.japanese: 「では失礼します」
lines.english: “Pardon me, then.”

lines.japanese: 今度は手を合わせて拝まれた。
lines.english: Now she pressed her palms together in a little prayer to me.

lines.japanese: 俺の体に掛けられていた毛布が、そろりそろりと脇からめくり上げられた。閉じこめられていた暖気が逃げて、体の片側に涼やかな風が吹きつけたみたいだ。
lines.english: The blanket over me was lifted slowly, carefully, from one side. The trapped warmth escaped, like a cool breeze blowing across half my body.

lines.japanese: 「っしょ、と……」
lines.english: “Heave... ho...”

lines.japanese: 鳴は膝を折ったまま、持ちあげた毛布の天幕が作る一人分の空き地に、小さな体をするっと滑りこませた。
lines.english: Still on her knees, Naru slipped her small body beneath the tent of raised blanket and into the empty space for one.

lines.japanese: 「へへー」
lines.english: “Hee-hee.”

lines.japanese: やつが手を放すと、落ちた天幕がふたつの体をひとつに繋いだ。逃げ場を失った匂いと体温が混ざりあう。俺と鳴のあいだにはこぶしひとつ分の隙間があるのに、どこか胸を焦がす密着感があった。
lines.english: When she let go, the falling canopy joined two bodies beneath one cover. Trapped scent and warmth mingled. A fist's breadth remained between Naru and me, yet the closeness somehow set my chest burning.

lines.japanese: こっそり首を傾け、さらに黒目を流して、薄ぼんやりした狭い視野にぎりぎりやつの姿を収めた。
lines.english: Secretly, I tilted my head, then slid my eyes farther still, just barely fitting her into my narrow, blurred field of vision.

lines.japanese: 鳴の顔がすぐ真横にあった。小娘くさい香りが漂ってくる。やつは毛布を鼻まで上げていたが、目の形でほくほく微笑んでいるのが分かった。
lines.english: Naru's face was right beside mine. A girlish scent drifted from her. She had pulled the blanket to her nose, but I could read the warm smile in the shape of her eyes.

lines.japanese: 「たははー」
lines.english: “Hee hee.”

lines.japanese: その笑顔はしばらく前後に小さく揺れていたが、突然ぴたりと止まった。
lines.english: For a while, that smile bobbed gently back and forth. Then it stopped dead.
“...Take that.”

lines.japanese: 鳴が毛布の中で体を傾け、軽く肩をぶつけてきた。何してんだこいつ。俺は思わず鼻から息を吹いてしまったが、やつは気付かなかった。
lines.english: Naru leaned beneath the blanket and bumped her shoulder lightly against mine. What was she doing? A breath escaped through my nose before I could stop it, but she didn't notice.

lines.japanese: 俺は目を閉じた。夜のしじまに家電製品の稼動音が染みわたる。触れあった箇所から熱が湧いてくるようで、心臓の鼓動が早まった。
lines.english: I closed my eyes. The hum of appliances soaked through the stillness of night. Heat seemed to well from the place where we touched, and my heart beat faster.

lines.japanese: それから鳴はしばらく動かなかった。また薄目を開けて覗きみると、やつもまぶたを下ろしていた。
lines.english: Naru stayed still for a while after that. When I peeked again through narrowed eyes, her lids had fallen too.

lines.japanese: そうして俺たちはふたり、互いの体温を感じあっていた。その退屈は存外に心地よいものだった。
lines.english: And so the two of us sat, feeling each other's warmth. The boredom was unexpectedly pleasant.
“Ah.”

lines.japanese: やがて鳴が傾けていた上体を戻した。そして──
lines.english: At last, Naru straightened her tilted body. Then—

lines.japanese: 「起きてますかー、ませんよねー」
lines.english: “Are you awake? No, of course you're not.”

lines.japanese: ──ぬくもりの離れた箇所を指先で突付いてきた。今度はなんだ。俺はまだ寝たふりを続けてみた。
lines.english: —she poked one fingertip into the place her warmth had left. What now? I kept pretending to sleep.

lines.japanese: するとやつは両手を使って、大胆にも、俺が胸の前で組んでいた二本の腕をほどきにかかった。
lines.english: Then, boldly using both hands, she began to pry apart the arms I'd folded over my chest.

lines.japanese: 力を抜いてされるがままにしてみると、解かれた俺の左腕は肘を伸ばしてソファーの崖っぷちに置かれた。
lines.english: I relaxed and let her do as she pleased. Once freed, my left arm was straightened and laid along the precipice of the sofa.

lines.japanese: 「へへへー」
lines.english: “Hee-hee-hee.”

lines.japanese: 上腕に軽い重しが載った。鳴が首を仰けぞらせて頭を置いていた。どうやら腕枕がしたかったらしい。
lines.english: A light weight settled on my upper arm. Naru had tipped back her neck and rested her head there. Apparently she'd wanted my arm for a pillow.
“Pff—”

lines.japanese: 限界だ。俺は思わず吹きだしてしまった。
lines.english: That was my limit. A laugh burst out of me.

lines.japanese: やつは弾かれたように毛布から飛びだして身をひるがえした。
lines.english: She sprang out from under the blanket and whirled around.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、あー、あのーですね……？」
lines.english: “Ah, um, well... You see...?”

lines.japanese: 「……あれ。なにしてんの」
lines.english: “...Huh? What are you doing?”

lines.japanese: 俺はすっとぼけて、たったいま目覚めたばかり風の低い声で聞いてみた。
lines.english: Feigning innocence, I asked in a low, just-woke-up voice.

lines.japanese: 「えっ──あ、あー、起、こしちゃい……ましたよね、あら、すいませんほんと」
lines.english: “What—oh, um, I w-woke you up... didn't I? Oh, I'm really sorry.”

lines.japanese: やつもまたすっとぼけていた。しかし、頭では平静を装おうとしていながら、舌と唇が対応しきれていないようだった。ついでに言えば、この暗さでも分かるぐらい顔が赤く燃えあがっていた。
lines.english: She too feigned innocence. Her mind tried to maintain composure, but her tongue and lips couldn't keep pace. And even in this darkness, I could see her face blazing red.

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なにおまえ、ここで寝てたの」
lines.english: “Huh? What, were you sleeping here?”

lines.japanese: 俺は首をすぐ真横に振りながら尋ねた。
lines.english: I asked, swiveling my head to face her inches away.

lines.japanese: 「え？　や、いえもう全然。私はあの、えっと、向こうの隅で──」
lines.english: “What? Oh, no, no, not at all. I was, um, over in that corner—”

lines.japanese: 鳴は人差し指をどこかへ向けようとふらふらさせていた。しかし、俺が抜け殻のように不自然な膨らみ方をしている毛布をしげしげ眺めていると、たちまちその指をひっこめてしまった。
lines.english: Naru wavered her index finger about, trying to point somewhere. But when I studied the blanket swollen unnaturally like an empty shell, she promptly pulled the finger back.

lines.japanese: 「──あー、そうですそうです。はい、そう言えばそこで寝てました」
lines.english: “—Ah, yes, yes. That's right. Come to think of it, I was asleep there.”

lines.japanese: 「や、違うんですよ。そう、あの、毛布。毛布が実は、家じゅう探せど探せど三枚しかなく。ええあの、なにぶん経済的に恵まれているとは言いがたい家なもので、はい、こればかりはもう、やむにやまれず」
lines.english: “No, you see, the problem is the blankets. Search the whole house and you’ll find only three. We are hardly a family of means, you know, so there was simply nothing else to be done.”

lines.japanese: 「そしたら、亜衣かパルさんとこで寝りゃ良かったじゃん」
lines.english: “Then you could've slept with Ai or Paru.”

lines.japanese: 「や、違うんですよ。そう、あの、いびき。実は亜衣ちゃん、いびきが凄まじくてですね、また一方のパルさんはこれ体臭が尋常ではな女性に対してなんてこと言うんですかあなた！　まったく失礼極まりますね！」
lines.english: “No, you see, the problem is the snoring. Ai’s snoring is ferocious, and Paru’s body odor is—how dare you say such a thing about a woman! Honestly, the nerve!”

lines.japanese: 舌の回りが良くなって、支離滅裂具合がいつも通りになってきた。もう混乱から脱したみたいだ。なんだ、面白くない。
lines.english: Her tongue had loosened, and her nonsense had returned to its usual form. Apparently she'd escaped her confusion. Damn. No fun.

lines.japanese: やつは首を巡らせながら、闇の中ふらりと立ちあがった。
lines.english: Turning her head this way and that, she rose unsteadily in the dark.

lines.japanese: 「あれー、えー、毛布まだあったはずなんだけどなー……どこだったっけなー」
lines.english: “That's odd. I was sure there was one more blanket somewhere... Where was it again?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょーちょー。おうコラ、どこ行くんだよ。んな、毛布が台所にあるわけねえだろ」
lines.english: “Hey, hey. Where the hell are you going? There isn't gonna be a blanket in the kitchen.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、や、なんかある気がするんですよ。前人未到の洞穴に赴くわけでもないので、念のため調べてまいります」
lines.english: “Oh, no, I have a feeling there may be. It's hardly an expedition into a cave where no human foot has trod, so I shall investigate, just in case.”

lines.japanese: 「いいから。来いよ」
lines.english: “Forget it. Come here.”

lines.japanese: 俺は毛布の片側をめくり上げて鳴を呼んだ。
lines.english: I lifted one side of the blanket and called her over.

lines.japanese: やつは閉めわすれた口をさらに広げて硬直した。
lines.english: She froze. Her mouth, which she had forgotten to close, fell open even wider.

lines.japanese: 「い、いえそんな、いきなり同衾なんていささかフライングが過ぎますし」
lines.english: “N-no, I couldn't. Sharing a bed this suddenly would be getting rather far ahead of ourselves.”

lines.japanese: 「なにがドーキンだ。いいからほら、入れよてめ。風邪とか引いちゃうだろコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Who said anything about a bed? Just get in here. You'll catch a cold, dammit.”

lines.japanese: 「む、無理です無理です。嫁入り前にそんな、私ふしだらな女じゃないですから」
lines.english: “I-I can't, I can't. Not before I'm married. I am not a wanton woman.”

lines.japanese: やつは頭を前に倒し、その先でてのひらを左右に振った。なに言ってるんだ今更。面白えやつ。
lines.english: She bowed her head and frantically waved both hands in front of it. A little late for that, wasn't it? What a funny girl.

lines.japanese: こらせっと。俺は腰を上げ、毛布を適当に畳んだ。
lines.english: Up we go. I got to my feet and folded the blanket any old way.

lines.japanese: 「使えよ。俺もう起きるから」
lines.english: “Use this. I'm getting up.”

lines.japanese: 畳んだそれをアンダースロウで放る。
lines.english: I tossed the folded blanket underhand.

lines.japanese: 「え……あ、はい、えええっ」
lines.english: “What... Oh, yes—what?”

lines.japanese: 「へぶっ！」
lines.english: “Mmph!”

lines.japanese: やつは咄嗟に両手を前に突きだしたものの、挟みそこねて顔面で受けとめていた。
lines.english: She thrust both hands out by reflex, missed the catch, and took it squarely in the face.

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんで…………まだ寝てていいですよー？　私、自分のベッドで寝ますから」
lines.english: “Why...? You can keep sleeping, you know. I'll sleep in my own bed.”

lines.japanese: 「え、ベッドあんのかよ。じゃあ最初からそこで寝てろよ。あとおまえ、そのなんかモノ受けとったらまずにおい嗅ぐって癖やめてくんない」
lines.english: “Wait, you have a bed? Then sleep there from the start. Also, could you quit sniffing everything the instant somebody hands it to you?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんで…………もう寝ないんですかー」
lines.english: “Why...? You're really not going back to sleep?”

lines.japanese: 「だから嗅ぐなっつってんだろ。いいんだよ、俺もう眠くないからいいんだよ」
lines.english: “I told you, stop sniffing it. It's fine. I'm not sleepy anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、じゃー、寝ないってあの、もう帰っちゃうんですかー」
lines.english: “Then, um, if you're not going to sleep... are you going home already?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　あー、そうなぁ」
lines.english: “Huh? Well... Yeah, I guess.”

lines.japanese: いまから眠るわけにはいかないし、パルさんには歩いて帰れって言われてる。いつの間にか宴会も終わってるみたいだし、むしろここに留まる理由が見当たらない──
lines.english: I couldn’t sleep now, and Paru had told me to walk home. The party seemed to have ended while I was out. I couldn’t think of any reason to stay.

lines.japanese: ──なにか大事なことをひとつ忘れてる気がするけれど。
lines.english: Except that I had the feeling I’d forgotten something important.

lines.japanese: 「あー……まー……」
lines.english: “Uh... Well...”

lines.japanese: 俺はクルマの中で交わしたパルさんとの会話を思いだしながら、広くて暗い空間をぐずぐずと見渡した。
lines.english: Remembering my conversation with Paru in the car, I searched the vast, dark room without much conviction.

lines.japanese: 「あ、そだ……したら俺、あのアレ、さっきの鍋の残りでも食ってるわ」
lines.english: “Oh, right... Then I'll, uh, eat some of what's left of that hot pot.”

lines.japanese: カウンターキッチンの奥──暗くてよく見えないけど、ガスコンロの上にあの土鍋が載ってるはずだ。そうだ、俺はいま腹が減っている。たぶん。
lines.english: Beyond the kitchen counter—it was too dark to see, but the earthenware pot should still be sitting on the gas stove. Right. I was hungry now. Probably.

lines.japanese: 「あら、そんなに美味しかったですか」
lines.english: “Oh my. Did you like it that much?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、どうかな。まあ、なに、荒削りだが光るものはあるってカンジ」
lines.english: “Hard to say. It’s rough around the edges, but it shows promise.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、それ美術の先生に言われたことある……」
lines.english: “Oh, my art teacher said that to me once...”

lines.japanese: 鳴はぶつぶつ呟きながら、毛布を綺麗に畳みなおして下に置いた。
lines.english: Muttering, Naru refolded the blanket neatly and set it down.

lines.japanese: 「えと、それじゃー、ちょっと座っててください。私、温めなおして持ってきますから」
lines.english: “Um, then please have a seat. I'll warm it up and bring it to you.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　いや、いいって。冷たくていいって」
lines.english: “Huh? No, that's fine. Cold is fine.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なんでですか？」
lines.english: “What? Why?”

lines.japanese: 「え、だってアレじゃん。そんな、お鍋コトコト言ったりとかして、パルさんたち起こしちゃったら悪いじゃん。いいよ、隅の方で軽く摘み食いするだけでいいよ」
lines.english: “Well, you know. If the pot starts burbling and wakes Paru and Ai, I'd feel bad. It's fine. I'll just pick at it in some corner.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、そう……ですねえ……」
lines.english: “Oh. I... see...”

lines.japanese: 鳴は言葉でも探すように、寝息を立てている女ふたりを見下ろした。
lines.english: As if searching for words, Naru looked down at the two sleeping women.

lines.japanese: 「分かりました、それじゃー私の部屋で食べましょう」
lines.english: “All right. Then let's eat it in my room.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: やつが足音を殺しながら、フローリングの床を渡ってキッチンへ向かう。俺はそのあとをゆっくり追って、カウンター越しに声をかけた。
lines.english: She padded across the wooden floor toward the kitchen. I followed slowly and called to her over the counter.

lines.japanese: 「つか、おまえ寝ないの」
lines.english: “Wait, aren't you sleeping?”

lines.japanese: 「二次会ですよー」
lines.english: “It's the after-party.”

lines.japanese: 夜も深いというのに楽しそうだった。
lines.english: It was late, but she sounded delighted.
